body.x: Morphing I Inc.(CEO Kim Ki Young) announced that it will participate in CES 2025, held from January 7th (Tuesday) to January 10th (Friday) in Las Vegas, USA, under the "K-Startup Pavilion."

Since its establishment in 2021, Morphing I has accumulated IT and software development expertise. Using advanced AI technology and robotics solutions, the company has revolutionized safety inspection processes for water and drainage pipes, focusing on preventing water resource loss and safety incidents.

In line with this vision, Morphing I developed Morphing-BOT, a robot designed to inspect the interiors of enclosed pipelines, such as water pipes, and detect abnormal signals. Morphing I will showcase this product at CES 2025 to showcase its technology and products to the global market.

Morphing-BOT uses AI algorithms developed in-house to analyze data in real-time and predict the condition of pipelines. The model can foresee leaks, damage, and contamination, enabling faster and more accurate diagnoses than traditional inspection methods. It also allows for 24-hour continuous monitoring, which is a significant advantage.

Additionally, Morphing-BOT integrates multimodal solutions to collect and analyze diverse data, including images, sounds, and vibrations, to evaluate pipeline conditions comprehensively. This capability enables it to diagnose structural abnormalities and their causes more accurately than traditional video-based inspection systems.

Morphing-BOT also supports a digital twin feature visualizing real-time data through 3D mapping. This feature lets users intuitively identify problem areas and integrate them with customers' BIM systems, improving operational and maintenance efficiency.

Moreover, Morphing-BOT enhances inspection quality through self-learning while eliminating human error, ensuring reliable inspections and evaluations. Its modular system adapts to various pipeline types, and its compliance with international standards allows it to inspect pipelines worldwide, including water and oil pipelines.

A Morphing I representative stated, “By showcasing our latest technologies, including Morphing-BOT, on the global stage at CES, we aim to emphasize Morphing I's competitiveness in pipeline inspection and management. CES is an excellent opportunity to connect with domestic and international businesses and investors, fostering global partnerships and expanding business cooperation.”

The representative added, “We hope to enhance our understanding of target countries and regional environments while strengthening localization strategies. This event allows us to analyze market trends, observe competitors’ products and technologies, and respond effectively to market changes.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally.
